program='''def rotate_cw(grid):
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]


def rotate_ccw(grid):
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]


def rotate_180(grid):
    return [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]


def transform(grid):
    top_right = rotate_cw(grid)
    bottom_left = rotate_ccw(grid)
    bottom_right = rotate_180(grid)
    top = [list(row) + list(rotated) for row, rotated in zip(grid, top_right)]
    bottom = [list(rotated) + list(other) for rotated, other in zip(bottom_left, bottom_right)]
    return top + bottom
'''
